metadata.title: Clicked like I was crushing chips and still got that 1 lucky kill? Valorant, what glitch is this?
metadata.description:
Me: wildly smashing buttons with zero clue
Enemy: probably uninstalling out of respect
Valorant just gave me a kill for no good reason

If your aim’s a mess but kills sneak in, you get it

Tap if your best kills are pure accident too!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
